rationale: A wins because it keeps its feet on the floor: "Already in 120,000 stores, Liquid Death is opening one of its own" is a clean strategic tension and the proof list asks the questions a reporter would ask. B has sharper instincts in places, especially "The canned water brand that named its store 'Country Club' just earned a B Corp certification," but it overreaches by treating timing and brand irony as more proven than the update supports. The difference is not elegance; it is discipline.
gaps_in_A: "Liquid Death certifies as a B Corp and says it has given $4.2M to clean-water nonprofits" is valid but a little under-shaped as a story; it needs a stronger tension than certification-plus-donation unless the score, recipients, or certification rationale are available.
"Story type: category-creation" for the store-merch-events angle is slightly inflated; the facts support experiential/brand strategy more cleanly than true category creation.

"The first permanent store is the live announcement" assumes announcement/opening timing that the update does not fully specify; A mostly catches this in uncomfortable questions, but the angle copy still leans on it.
gaps_in_B: "earned institutional ESG certification in the same quarter it opens that store" quietly turns two same-quarter facts into a combined news peg; the update does not say they are coordinated or simultaneous enough to carry that tension.

"the prevailing belief is that B Corp certification belongs to earnest, mission-forward brands in wellness, food, or apparel" is an invented premise. It may be plausible, but it is not in the update and would need outside proof.

"Profitable at contribution margin, Liquid Death opens a flagship. The financial bet is implied." is too speculative for the supplied facts; a flagship can be marketing, retail, community, or content infrastructure, not automatically a capital-allocation signal worth a finance reporter.

"the company's approximate founding year to contextualize the cumulative $4.2M donation figure" appears as proof in the financial angle even though the donation figure is not load-bearing there; the proof list starts wandering.
